messages:
nina (Product): quick sync — we need final decisions for GA clearance tomorrow morning. core buckets: SLAs (p99 latency / availability), docs scope, support coverage (SOW + oncall), monitoring dashboards + alerting, pricing tiers for pilot vs GA. who can own the final numbers? cc @raj @marc @olive @sara
raj (Eng-Platform): I can own the latency SLO targets. proposing p50 120ms, p95 250ms, p99 450ms for hosted small model tier. larger models we should flag separately. needs signoff from product/finops.
marc (Eng-SRE): availability target I'd push for 99.95% for hosted GA. also need explicit fallback policy for capacity shortages (route to compatible variant or degraded QPS). we need runbooks documented in docs.
olive (FinOps): pricing proposal draft: pilot discount (30% off baseline) for early customers, GA tiers with committed QPS bundles + overage. I'll put numbers in spreadsheet but need the SLA cost model from raj/marc to validate.
sara (Support): for GA support we need 24x5 coverage first 90 days, with on-call rotated across infra+platform. support runbook must include escalation matrix + service owner contacts. will need a doc link by EOD.
raj (Eng-Platform): note: latency targets assume current batching config + KV cache enabled. if product wants stricter p99 we either increase dedicated capacity or push quantization options.
nina (Product): thanks — can we map owners: SLAs/latency = raj, availability + fallback = marc, pricing = olive, support runbook = sara, docs + user-facing rollout notes = me. agree?
marc (Eng-SRE): agreed. I'll draft fallback policy (canary -> degrade -> region-failover) and mock incident flows.
olive (FinOps): agreed. olive: I'll attach a draft spreadsheet later today. also need to decide minimum commit for Dedicated customers (suggest 3 months).
sara (Support): I'll author runbook template and put it in product docs. will need a 1h walkthrough with oncall team before GA.
nina (Product): here's an acceptance checklist I'm going to use for the shiproom — feel free to copy/edit:```
- SLAs defined and signed (p50/p95/p99, availability)
- Billing/pricing tiers & sample invoices
- Support coverage + runbooks + playbooks
- Monitoring dashboards (latency, errors, capacity) + alert thresholds
- Rollout plan (canary, ramp, fallback)
- Docs: quickstart, troubleshooting, API changes
- Compliance/contract exceptions logged
```
raj (Eng-Platform): small clarification: for monitoring we need tokenized cost telemetry per model route. is that in scope for GA or post-GA?
olive (FinOps): cost telemetry per route is important for pricing sanity — propose GA includes basic token cost breakdown, full tokenized routing breakdown post-GA (30d).
nina (Product): ok capture: GA = basic cost telemetry + per-route summary. full breakdown is backlog item.
marc (Eng-SRE): one more: alerts we depend on SLO burn rate + absolute p99 spikes. I'll create the grafana dashboard and add runbook links.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary deployment for release v2.1 at 2024-11-07T05:00:00Z (owner: raj).
raj (Eng-Platform): action items: I'll publish SLA doc + latency test harness by 17:00 PT. need product signoff.
olive (FinOps): action: upload pricing spreadsheet + sample committed bundle scenarios by 18:00 PT.
sara (Support): action: runbook draft + invite for walkthrough (slots: 10am or 3pm PT) — prefer 3pm.
nina (Product): I'll consolidate signoffs into the GA checklist and ping legal for contract SOW language. can folks react with :thumbsup: when you own item?
raj (Eng-Platform): :thumbsup:
olive (FinOps): :thumbsup: 
marc (Eng-SRE): :thumbsup: 
sara (Support): :thumbsup: 
nina (Product): great — final sync 08:30 PT tomorrow in shiproom. if anything blocks, drop here.
